percentage_strength.heading: strength multiplier
percentage_strength.paragraph:
common sources includes:

  • golden / ender dragon
  • renowned
  • unlimited power

note that the game rounds to first decimal place, and you must check individual sources yourself and sum them up.

for example, with maxed attributes, it will show 1.8% by default, but it is actually 1.75%.

percentage_crit_damage.heading: crit damage multiplier
percentage_crit_damage.paragraph:
common sources includes:

  • ender dragon
  • renowned
  • unlimited energy

note that the game rounds to first decimal place, and you must check individual sources yourself and sum them up.

for example, with maxed attributes, it will show 1.8% by default, but it is actually 1.75%.

percentage_damage_bonus.heading: percentage damage bonus
percentage_damage_bonus.paragraph:
common sources includes:

  • combat levels
  • golden dragon
  • enchants
  • attributes

you need to sum up the bonuses from your combat levels, enchantments and attributes (towards specific types of enemies).

tip: only the warrior/deadeye/dominance shard affects it if you changed the dummy into a slime.

if you did so, dominance and warrior/deadeye is +40%.

final_damage.heading: damage output
final_damage.paragraph:

you can change it to 69,420 or 676,767 for funny tho 😔
